spokenText: Welcome home, Daddy. Here is your briefing for Sunday, the fifteenth of November. Forex: the Bank of Zambia's latest published mid-rate is 20.44 kwacha to the US dollar, as of Friday the thirteenth of November, buying at 20.42 and selling at 20.47. That is up from about 20.40 on Tuesday, so the kwacha weakened slightly this week. Market rates this morning are around 20.43. Email: I couldn't check your inbox this time. The Gmail connection has expired and needs you to sign in again in your Claude connector settings. Once that's done, I'll include your email summary and flag what needs your attention. Calendar: your calendar is clear. There are no events or appointments between now and the end of January. Tayant Pay: the August tab shows 101 customer transactions across 26 trading days. 93 are dated August third to thirty-first, plus 8 more at the bottom dated August first and second, which may actually be September entries. The Zambia ledger took in 146,816 kwacha and paid out 114,255 kwacha, earning 1,114 kwacha and 56 ngwee in revenue, with 210 kwacha in fees. The Russia ledger earned 12,200 rubles in revenue. One heads-up: the August tab now also holds September to November entries, so the 48,388 kwacha revenue total at the top of the sheet covers all of those months, not just August. That's your briefing.

forex.source: Bank of Zambia published rates: Nov 13 mid 20.4402 (buy 20.4152 / sell 20.4652); 'previous' is the Nov 12 BoZ average (buy 20.3998 / sell 20.4498). boz.zm is JS-rendered, so figures came via search of BoZ pages; market rate on Nov 15 ≈ 20.43 (exchangerate-api).

The tab now also contains Sept–Nov data, so the sheet's header total (K48,387.56) is not August-only.
